items.html: However, after this clothing, her VAK spread in Yetzira — and this is the secret of "six Sefirot nest in Yetzira." And her VAK become a Neshama to the VAK that are drawn to Yetzira from the coupling of ZON of Atzilut, as above. And her Malchut spreads in Assiya, and she is a Neshama to the aspect of the light drawn to Assiya from the back-to-back coupling of ZON of Atzilut, as above.
